第72章 独自受伤-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

存书签

下一章

地府的贡献制度是这样的，抓一只游魂，奖励10点贡献；抓一只怨灵，奖励50点贡献；到了厉鬼级别，贡献点就直线上升，厉鬼初期500点，厉鬼中期1000点，厉鬼后期2000点；至于恶鬼级以上，那更是一个分水岭了，贡献点的奖励吴姜每一次看到，都眼馋的不得了。

而且，只要不是地府派发的任务，他自己抓捕的鬼物、邪修，送下去之后，还能额外获得一些贡献点奖励。

不过，最赚贡献点的，还是完成一些特殊的任务，比如之前送苏婉清的魂魄去地府，就足足奖励了他1000点贡献，协助抓捕恶鬼那一次，因为是越级完成，难度极大，那一次直接奖励了他5000点，可谓是一夜暴富。

这次的奖励，男鬼是厉鬼初期，奖励了500点，女鬼是厉鬼中期，奖励了1000点，鬼道人一个人就奖励了4000点，再加上额外奖励的500点，刚好六千点。

吴姜笑的牙花子都露出来了，又看了下贡献点余额，已经攒了9000多点了！

他平时基本上不怎么花贡献点，最大的开销，就是之前买的术法《镇魂定身印》了，但他敢说，他现在比起奋斗了几十年的赵安坤，还要富裕的多。

最值得开心的是，距离晋升一等鬼差，又近了一大步。

晋升一等鬼差，有一个硬性先决条件，除了需要鬼卒后期境以外，就是贡献度累积需要达到两万点，按照现在的速度，再抓几个厉鬼，他就能满足晋升条件了。

他美滋滋地收起阴差令牌，等晚上从老妈那里回来，就去兑换中心看看，有没有什么好东西，也该好好消费一波了。

奖励了自己一瓶快乐水，拿出手机，给云川打了一个电话，得知他还在茅山等着，依旧没有半点恶鬼的消息，他和师傅商量好了，再等两天，要是恶鬼还没出现，他们就先回龙虎山了。

吴姜也很无奈，他已经汇报给地府了，各地的日夜游神，都没有发现恶鬼的踪迹。

挂了和云川的电话，吴姜看了看时间，差不多该去老妈那里了。

吴时安早就给他租好了车位，就在自家单元楼楼下，停好车后，吴姜开始往下搬东西，足足跑了三趟，才将后备箱彻底清空。

郭大民一共给他车上放了五箱茅台和十条华子，吴姜给自己家里留了一箱酒和一条烟，剩下的三箱茅台和八条烟，全给老爹搬了过去。

吴时安看着地上的烟酒，乐不可支的和老婆申请，一脸的谄媚：“老婆，都是儿子孝敬的，晚上能不能少喝点？”

王雅琴白了他一眼，但也没扫了他的兴致。

“最多三两，超了一滴，你知道后果！”

“得嘞，老婆大人最好了！”

The contribution system of the underworld is like this. If you catch a wandering spirit, you will be rewarded with 10 contribution points; if you catch a wraith, you will be rewarded with 50 contribution points; when you reach the level of a ghost, the contribution points will rise straight up, 500 points in the early stage of the ghost, 1000 points in the middle stage of the ghost, and 2000 points in the late stage of the ghost. As for the evil ghost level and above, it is a watershed. Every time Wu Jiang sees the reward of contribution points, he is extremely greedy.

Moreover, as long as it is not a task assigned by the underworld, he can get some additional contribution point rewards after sending the ghosts and evil cultivators he captures.

However, the most profitable contribution points are to complete some special tasks. For example, sending Su Wanqing's soul to the underworld previously rewarded him with 1,000 contribution points. The time he helped capture the evil ghost was extremely difficult because it was completed at a higher level. That time, he was directly rewarded with 5,000 points, which can be said to make him rich overnight.

This time, the reward for this time was 500 points for the male ghost who was in the early stage of the Evil Ghost, and 1,000 points for the female ghost who was in the middle stage of the Evil Ghost. The Ghost Taoist alone was rewarded with 4,000 points, plus an additional 500 points, which was exactly 6,000 points.

Wu Jiang smiled with his teeth exposed. He looked at the balance of his contribution points and found that he had saved more than 9,000 points!

He usually doesn't spend much on contribution points. The biggest expense is the "Soul-Suppressing Seal" he bought before, but he dares to say that he is now much richer than Zhao Ankun, who has been struggling for decades.

The most gratifying thing is that we are a big step closer to being promoted to the first-class ghost officer.

There is a hard prerequisite for promotion to the first-class ghost warrior. In addition to the late-stage ghost soldier, the accumulation of contribution points needs to reach 20,000 points. At the current speed, he can meet the promotion conditions by catching a few more ghosts.

He happily put away the Yin difference token, and when he came back from his mother's house in the evening, he went to the exchange center to see if there were any good things, and it was time to spend some money.

He rewarded himself with a bottle of happy water, took out his mobile phone, and called Yunchuan. He learned that he was still waiting in Maoshan, and there was still no news about the evil ghost. He and his master agreed to wait two more days, and if the evil ghost hadn't appeared yet, they would go back to Longhu Mountain first.

Wu Jiang was also helpless. He had already reported it to the underworld. The wandering gods everywhere found no trace of the evil ghost.

After hanging up the phone with Yunchuan, Wu Jiang looked at the time. It was almost time to go to his mother's place.

Wu Shi'an had rented a parking space for him a long time ago, just downstairs from his unit. After parking the car, Wu Jiang began to move his things down, and it took him three trips to completely empty the trunk.

Guo Damin put a total of five boxes of Maotai and ten cartons of Huazi in his car. Wu Jiang left a box of wine and a carton of cigarettes at home, and the remaining three boxes of Maotai and eight cartons of cigarettes were moved to his father.

Wu Shi'an looked at the cigarettes and alcohol on the ground, and happily applied to his wife, with a flattering look on his face: "My wife, my son is a filial piety, can you drink less tonight?"

Wang Yaqin rolled her eyes at him, but did not dampen his interest.

"At most three taels, if it exceeds one drop, you know the consequences!"

"Come on, my wife is the best!"
